Global (All).title: Ransomware attack targets US critical infrastructure
Global (All).summary: A sophisticated ransomware attack has been launched against US critical infrastructure, posing a significant risk to national security and economic stability.

Global (All).title: Global economic downturn amid rising inflation
Global (All).summary: A global economic downturn is forecasted due to rising inflation, potentially leading to widespread job losses and socio-economic instability.

Global (All).title: Social media platform hack exposes user data
Global (All).summary: A popular social media platform has been hacked, exposing sensitive user data, highlighting the importance of robust cybersecurity measures.

United States.title: US-China Relations Tension Escalated by Speaker Pelosi's Visit
United States.summary: The recent visit of US Speaker Pelosi to Taiwan has heightened tensions between the US and China, sparking fears of a military conflict.

United States.title: FBI Searches Trump's Mar-a-Lago Estate
United States.summary: The FBI has executed a search warrant at former US President Trump's Mar-a-Lago estate, sparking allegations of politicization and potential obstruction of justice.

United States.title: US Senate Passes Inflation Reduction Act
United States.summary: The US Senate has passed the Inflation Reduction Act, a major climate and healthcare bill, despite opposition from some Democrats and Republicans.

South Korea.title: South Korea reports North Korea fired two ballistic missiles
South Korea.summary: South Korea's military says North Korea fired two ballistic missiles into the ocean off its eastern coast on Wednesday, amid heightened tensions between the rival nations. The missiles were fired from the Sunan area in North Pyongan Province, which is where North Korea's capital, Pyongyang, is located.

South Korea.title: South Korea's President Yoon seeks to boost US ties amid North Korea tensions
South Korea.summary: South Korean President Yoon Suk-yeol met with US lawmakers on Wednesday to boost ties with the US as tensions with North Korea escalate. The meeting comes as the US and South Korean militaries stage large-scale joint exercises, which have been criticized by North Korea as "aggressive".

South Korea.title: South Korea's opposition party demands president's resignation over corruption scandal
South Korea.summary: South Korea's main opposition party on Wednesday demanded President Yoon Suk-yeol's resignation over a corruption scandal that has engulfed the president's office. The scandal involves a former top aide who allegedly laundered billions of won through a local church, and has sparked widespread outrage in the country.

Japan.title: Japan’s ruling party suffers defeat in local election, a setback for Prime Minister Fumio Kishida
Japan.summary: On July 30, the ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) lost control of Niigata Prefecture, dealing a blow to Prime Minister Fumio Kishida’s plans to revise the country’s constitution.

Japan.title: Japan struggles to cope with rising number of COVID-19 cases as healthcare system faces pressure
Japan.summary: Japan has confirmed over 10,000 new COVID-19 cases in the past week, putting pressure on the country’s healthcare system. The government has announced plans to provide additional funding and resources to support hospitals and medical staff.

Japan.title: Japan’s inflation rate remains high, fueling concerns about economic stability
Japan.summary: Japan’s inflation rate rose to 3.5% in July, higher than expected. The government has warned that the country faces economic uncertainty due to high inflation and global economic trends.
